name: web-fashion-hero-with-dark-portrait-and-periwinkle-fleece
title: Fashion homepage with a periwinkle hero, giant 'STYLISH LIFE' behind a model and a dark portrait header
whatItIs: A dark navy header with a small studio credit and a moody portrait, then a white page with centred logo and menu and a large periwinkle gradient hero where 'STYLISH LIFE' in giant white caps sits behind a model in a violet fleece, with small corner captions and a New arrival row starting below.
whatItMeans: Sleek and youthful; type behind the model creates depth.
techniques: Place giant type behind a cutout model.
Use a gradient hero with small captions in corners.
Keep a plain white centred nav.
Colour the product to match the gradient.

vocabulary.definition: Giant text placed behind a person.
A logo and menu centred at the top.
